title: How can we help wild bees?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why are wild bees important even for people who do not care much about insects?
Which would help bees more in cities: more flowers, fewer pesticides, or more nesting spaces?
Should private gardens and public parks be managed differently to support pollinators?
Would you accept a less tidy-looking park if it supported more wildlife?
What simple action could households take that would genuinely help wild bees?
